record.original_question: Is there a smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domain in C^n on which the Kobayashi and Caratheodory metrics are not comparable?

evidence.quote: Problem 7.3.2 Is there a smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domain in Cn on which the Kobayashi and Caratheodory metrics are not comparable? -S. Krantz, SK@math.wustl.edu 7.4 Finite Type

artifact.category_tag: Invariant metrics in several complex variables
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a bounded domain. For $z \in \Omega$ and $v \in \mathbb{C}^n$, define the infinitesimal Kobayashi (pseudo)metric by
$$F_\Omega^K(z,v) = \inf\{\,|\alpha| > 0 : \exists\, f:\mathbb{D} \to \Omega \text{ holomorphic with } f(0)=z,\ f'(0) = v/\alpha\,\},$$
where $\mathbb{D}$ denotes the open unit disk in $\mathbb{C}$, and the infinitesimal Carathéodory (pseudo)metric by
$$F_\Omega^C(z,v) = \sup\{\,|df(z)\,v| : f : \Omega \to \mathbb{D} \text{ holomorphic}\,\}.$$
One always has $F_\Omega^C(z,v) \le F_\Omega^K(z,v)$. Say that the Kobayashi and Carathéodory metrics on $\Omega$ are comparable if there exists a constant $C > 0$ such that
$$F_\Omega^K(z,v) \le C\, F_\Omega^C(z,v) \quad \text{for all } z \in \Omega,\ v \in \mathbb{C}^n.$$
Recall that $\Omega$ is pseudoconvex if $-\log \mathrm{dist}(\cdot,\partial\Omega)$ is plurisubharmonic on $\Omega$, and smoothly bounded if $\partial\Omega$ is a $C^\infty$ submanifold of $\mathbb{C}^n$.

Question: Does there exist a smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ on which the Kobayashi and Carathéodory metrics are not comparable?
artifact.status_search_result: A search of the literature on the Kobayashi and Carathéodory metrics on smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domains turns up many comparability results for restricted classes (strongly pseudoconvex domains, convex domains, and certain finite type / Levi corank one domains), but no construction of a smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domain in $\mathbb{C}^n$ on which the two metrics are provably not comparable, nor a proof of comparability in full generality. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Some Aspects of the Kobayashi and Carathéodory Metrics on Pseudoconvex Domains
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys comparability results for these metrics under various pseudoconvexity hypotheses; equivalence is established only under restrictive assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Comparability between Kobayashi and Carathéodory metrics is known only under restrictive geometric hypotheses (strong pseudoconvexity, finite type with Levi corank conditions, etc.).

status_evidence.title: Pseudoconvexity, Analytic Discs, and Invariant Metrics (S. Krantz)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of open questions concerning the relationship between Kobayashi and Carathéodory metrics on smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domains.
status_evidence.claim: Krantz lists the comparability of these metrics on smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domains as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Bounds for invariant distances on pseudoconvex Levi corank one domains and applications
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes comparability on Levi corank one finite type domains.
status_evidence.claim: Comparability results have been extended beyond strongly pseudoconvex domains, but the general smoothly bounded pseudoconvex case is not resolved.
